service.description: What a tenant can send: its audits, saved runs and connections, for the transfer's pick and map steps.

parameter.name: audits
parameter.description: [{auditId, auditCode, auditName, statementCount, checkCount}] sorted by auditCode.

parameter.name: runs
parameter.description: [{savedRunId, ruleSetName, auditCodes}]: the tenant's saved runs and the audits whose checks use each.

parameter.name: connections
parameter.description: [{ref, kind, id, description, granted}]: owned connections and those shared to the tenant (granted: true).

service.description: The bundle a target imports: the picked audits with every statement, check, run, query, conclusion code and connection they reach, plus picked runs and connections. Ids travel as refs; secrets never travel.

parameter.name: savedRunIds
parameter.description: Saved runs to send on their own, by savedRunId.

parameter.name: connectionRefs
parameter.description: Connections to send that no picked audit or run reaches, as KIND:id refs from the catalog.

parameter.name: sourceInstanceLabel
parameter.description: This instance's name as the operator knows it, e.g. local.

parameter.name: bundle
parameter.description: {bundleVersion, source, connections, queries, conclusionCodes, runs, audits, statements, checks}; consumed unchanged by import#ConfigBundle.

service.description: Plans a bundle into a target tenant (apply false: a dry run that writes nothing) or applies the plan previewed (apply true with its planHash), in one transaction: all of it or none of it.

parameter.name: connectionMap
parameter.description: {connection ref: an existing target connection id, or CREATE}, one entry per bundle connection.

parameter.name: planHash
parameter.description: Required with apply: the planHash of the preview being applied.

parameter.name: plan
parameter.description: {lines: [{kind, ref, label, action (CREATE | UPDATE | UNCHANGED | MAPPED | NEEDS_CREDENTIALS), targetId, changes: [{field, from, to}]}], blocking: [{code, ref, message}], warnings: [{code, ref, message}], counts: {action: n}}.

parameter.name: planHash
parameter.description: SHA-256 of the bundle, connection map, target tenant and plan.

parameter.name: idMap
parameter.description: When applied: every bundle ref to its target id.

parameter.name: applied
parameter.description: True when the plan was written.
